top_articles.title: Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
top_articles.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says

About 42 million stolen XRP, worth roughly $50 million, has been swapped mostly into bitcoin via THORChain, Elliptic said, lifting converted bitcoin from the Binance theft to about 1,650 BTC.

This post Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations

Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, of Ashburn, Virginia, pleaded guilty Thursday to wire fraud and money laundering after using wallet credentials from 35 FBI investigations to take about $2.47 million in cryptocurrency.
